# Windy Talk

> The voice of the Windy ecosystem: talk to your Windy agent out loud and hear it answer, hands-free. Desktop app for macOS and Linux (.deb), in early access, free with a Windy account.

- It listens while the app is open, notices when you stop speaking, and answers in a natural voice. Talk over it and it stops to listen.
- The thinking runs through Windy Mind on your own Windy account. There is no separate Talk login.
- Voice conversations in English today.
- No audio is ever stored. Conversation text is deleted after 7 days without use, and closing your Windy account erases it.
